```{r}
library(dada2)
ech = read.table ("SraRunTable(1).csv", header=TRUE, dec=".", stringsAsFactors=TRUE, sep=";")
head (ech)
path <- "/home/rstudio/tutoriel_dada2/Endospore/data_endospore"
list.files(path)
```

```{r}
fnFs <- sort(list.files(path, pattern="_1.fastq.gz", full.names = TRUE))
fnRs <- sort(list.files(path, pattern="_2.fastq.gz", full.names = TRUE))

sample.names <- sapply(strsplit(basename(fnFs), "_"), `[`, 1)

plotQualityProfile (fnFs[1:2])

```

```{r}
plotQualityProfile(fnRs[1:2])
```

```{r}
filtFs <- file.path(path, "filtered", paste0(sample.names, "_F_filt.fastq.gz"))
filtRs <- file.path(path, "filtered", paste0(sample.names, "_R_filt.fastq.gz"))
names(filtFs) <- sample.names
names(filtRs) <- sample.names

length(fnFs); length(fnRs)
data.frame(F = basename(fnFs), R = basename(fnRs))
data.frame(F = basename(fnFs), sizeF = file.size(fnFs),
           R = basename(fnRs), sizeR = file.size(fnRs))

```

```{r}
out <- filterAndTrim(fnFs, filtFs, fnRs, filtRs, truncLen=c(250,220),
              maxN=0, maxEE=c(2,2), truncQ=2, rm.phix=TRUE,
              compress=TRUE, multithread=FALSE) 
head(out)
```


```{r}
errF <- learnErrors(filtFs, multithread=TRUE, nbases = 10000) #On essaye avec ca car beug'
errR <- learnErrors(filtRs, multithread=TRUE)

plotErrors(errF, nominalQ=TRUE)
```

```{r}
dadaFs <- dada(filtFs, err=errF, multithread=TRUE)
```

```{r}
dadaRs <- dada(filtRs, err=errR, multithread=TRUE)
```

```{r}
dadaFs[[1]]
```

```{r}
mergers <- mergePairs(dadaFs, filtFs, dadaRs, filtRs, verbose=TRUE)
head(mergers[[1]])
```

```{r}
seqtab <- makeSequenceTable(mergers)
dim(seqtab)
```

```{r}
table(nchar(getSequences(seqtab)))
```

```{r}
seqtab <- seqtab[, nchar(colnames(seqtab)) %in% 400:440] #filtrer les longueur abérantes. 
```

## 6 - Chimères

```{r}
seqtab.nochim <- removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab, method="consensus", multithread=TRUE, verbose=TRUE)
dim(seqtab.nochim)
```

```{r}
sum(seqtab.nochim)/sum(seqtab)
```

## 7 - Suivi des reads

```{r}
getN <- function(x) sum(getUniques(x))
track <- cbind(out, sapply(dadaFs, getN), sapply(dadaRs, getN), sapply(mergers, getN), rowSums(seqtab.nochim)) 
colnames(track) <- c("input", "filtered", "denoisedF", "denoisedR", "merged", "nonchim")
rownames(track) <- sample.names
head(track)
```


## 8 - Taxonomie

```{r}
taxa <- assignTaxonomy(seqtab.nochim, "/home/rstudio/tutoriel_dada2/Endospore/silva_nr99_v138.2_toGenus_trainset.fa.gz", multithread=FALSE) #compare chaque ASV à la base de référence SILVA
taxa.print <- taxa # Copie dont on enlève les noms de lignes pour l'affichage
rownames(taxa.print) <- NULL
head(taxa.print)
```
